title: Normalize provider identifiers before route lookup
capture_reason: A verified normalization gap caused the same routing failure twice.

content.problem: Mixed-case provider identifiers bypassed the configured route.
content.investigation: The registry was correct, but lookup used the raw identifier.
content.root_cause: Provider identifiers were compared before normalization.
content.solution: Normalize identifiers before consulting the route registry.
content.why_it_works: Every lookup now uses the registry's canonical key format.
content.prevention: Keep the mixed-case route fixture in the runtime suite.
content.verification: The representative route fixture selects the configured provider.

claims.statement: The fixture contains the provider route.
